dict.string: Fitness Doodle needs your precise location to record your walking paths.
Fitness Doodle needs location access to continue tracking your path even when the app is in the background or your phone is locked.
Fitness Doodle uses motion data to detect when you are moving, improving path accuracy and saving battery.
Fitness Doodle needs camera access to let you take photos during your walks that can be overlaid with your doodle route.
Fitness Doodle needs photo library access to save images for sharing to Instagram Stories.
